patch_description:
Add a dedicated optimizer for antipodal 14-point configurations.  Such a configuration is determined by seven unit vectors representing unoriented lines, with the returned points being each vector and its negative.  Its diameter is exactly 2, while its minimum distance is controlled by the largest absolute inner product between distinct line representatives.  This reduces the relevant search from 14 general points to the well-studied seven-line packing problem in R^3.

The added deterministic multi-start projected optimization minimizes a progressively sharpened soft maximum of squared pairwise line correlations.  It includes the existing cube-plus-axis line arrangement as a structured start, together with fixed-seed random starts.  Every resulting candidate is still evaluated with the original exact ratio function before replacing the general optimizer's best result.
